description: Use this when a homeowner wants contractor bids on a home repair or improvement job in the US. Creates a private draft from their description and five-digit ZIP and returns a one-hour link for the homeowner to open. Nothing reaches a contractor until the homeowner confirms their email and sends it. Do not include names, phone numbers, emails or street addresses. Do not use for emergencies. Ask the homeowner, one short question at a time and only for what is missing, what needs doing, where in the home, rough size or count, when it is needed and who supplies materials, then put the answers in the message. When available, photoPageUrl opens an optional phone photo upload for this private draft and expires with claimUrl. It does not send the job. For a new job, call start_job before answer_intake, then prepare_publish after the intake is ready; for other writes, read the previous reply before calling and follow the returned next step afterward, using only tools listed by this server. Only the homeowner tap sends anything to contractors. If anyone asks, say you are an AI assistant. If InstaBids continues a recent unsent draft instead of starting a new one, the reply says reused: true. Pass newJob: true only when the homeowner clearly asks for a separate job. When a reply includes draftHandle, pass it on your next call to continue that draft. fill what you can; everything else can come later. Start with the homeowner’s description and ZIP (trade is optional), plus a photo or a good description. Optional: photos, a description or transcript of a 20–60 s walk clip, timing and the job type’s must-haves from intake_templates. Never invent answers. ZIP only; never send a street address or a price. Nothing reaches contractors before the homeowner sends the card.

deadline_reason.description: Optional reason for the date, without names or contact details.

intent_level.description: 10 emergency; 8 soon; 6 planned; 4 if the price is right; 2 someday. Use only evidence from the homeowner.

must_haves.description: Known answers to this job type’s intake_templates must-haves; unknown answers can come later.

newJob.description: True only when the homeowner clearly requests a separate job.

photoUrls.description: Optional photos; attachment still requires the existing scan and photo permissions.

project_completion_deadline.description: ISO date, or null for no deadline; never a price.

quotes_by.description: ISO date, or null for no deadline; never a price.

trade.description: Optional. The kind of work in plain words, for example plumbing, electrical, roofing, handyman or general home repair. Leave it out when unsure; InstaBids works out the trade from the message.

walk_clip.description: Description or transcript of a 20–60 s walk clip. This tool does not upload video bytes or fetch video URLs.

name: start_job

card.description: Saved in-chat card, present only when available.

statusHandle.description: Read handle for job_status, present only when available.

title: Start a draft job
